metadata.question: Does the area around (43.244129, -79.198692) apprear greener than (43.263113, -79.069485) in Lake Ontario on February 4, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good for vegetation analysis with NDVI, available at 10m resolution) - Date: February 4, 2021 (specific date) - Locations: Two points in/around Lake Ontario, Canada * Point 1: (43.244129, -79.198692) * Point 2: (43.263113, -79.069485) - Create small buffers around each point to get representative areas 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask using QA60 band (cloud probability) - Water mask using NDVI or other indices since we're looking at Lake Ontario - The question asks about "greener" so we need vegetation index (NDVI) - Note: Lake Ontario is mostly water, so vegetation will be limited/sparse. Need to check if valid pixels exist. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: - C1: If Sentinel-2 has no images on Feb 4, 2021 for the location - C2: If after cloud masking, no valid pixels remain (common for cloudy dates or water) - C3: If NDVI values are invalid (NaN, out of expected range) - A: Point 1 NDVI > Point 2 NDVI (greener) - B: Point 1 NDVI ≤ Point 2 NDVI (not greener) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the two points with small buffers const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([−79.198692, 43.244129]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([−79.069485, 43.263113]); const buffer = 500; // 500m buffer around each point const geom1 = point1.buffer(buffer); const geom2 = point2.buffer(buffer); // Date of interest const date = '2021-02-04'; const startDate = '2021-02-01'; const endDate = '2021-02-07'; // Sentinel-2 collection with cloud masking let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geom1.union(geom2)); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); print(`S2 Images in range: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { print("No Sentinel-2 images found for date range."); print("C1"); return; } // Cloud mask function function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask); } // Calculate NDVI function calcNDVI(img) { const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return img.addBands(ndvi); } col = col.map(maskClouds).map(calcNDVI); // Get median composite const composite = col.median(); // Extract NDVI for both points const ndvi1Result = composite.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom1, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndvi2Result = composite.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom2, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts to detect valid data const count1 = composite.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom1, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2 = composite.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom2, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndvi1 = ndvi1Result.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2 = ndvi2Result.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const pixels1 = count1.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const pixels2 = count2.get('NDVI').getInfo(); print(`Point1 NDVI: ${ndvi1 !== null ? ndvi1.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${pixels1}`); print(`Point2 NDVI: ${ndvi2 !== null ? ndvi2.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${pixels2}`); // Validation if (pixels1 === 0 || pixels2 === 0) { print("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); print("C2"); return; } if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2)) { print("Invalid NDVI calculation."); print("C3"); return; } if (ndvi1 > ndvi2) { print("Point 1 is greener than Point 2."); print("A"); } else { print("Point 1 is not greener than Point 2."); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
